newsitem.title: USA: First Merchants engages Greenwich Capital.
newsitem.headline: First Merchants engages Greenwich Capital.

text.p: First Merchants Acceptance Corp said on Tuesday it engaged Greenwich Capital Markets Inc to provide a financing package including the purchase of certain loans and a warehouse line of credit.
The company also said it was progressing in the review of its 1996 and first quarter results and expected to release them before the end of June.
Greenwich would also provide a working capital line and a commitment to underwrite or serve as placement agent for securitizations for the company, First Merchants said.
The financing package was subject to the execution of definitive agreements, satisfactory completion of due diligence and certain other conditions.
The engagement letter provides that Greenwich Capital would purchase a pool of existing sub-prime auto finance loans from First Merchants totaling about $50 million, it said.
This deal was expected to close by the end of week, First Merchants said.
Greenwich Capital would provide First Merchants with a $200 million warehouse facility, replacing the existing bank syndicated line of credit, First Merchants said.
This facility was expected to provide a higher advance rate than the existing facility, it said.
Long term financing would also be supplied by Greenwich Capital through their commitment to underwrite or place up to $1 billion of asset backed securities, it said.

In addition to its customary fees and interest from the credit facilities and loan purchases, Greenwich Capital would receive warrants to purchase a combination of voting and non-voting shares equal to 15 percent of First Merchants's stock at a price equal to the average of recent market prices.
